reviews.title: Surprised and delighted!
reviews.contents: I’ll admit I was a little skeptical when downloading this app. I’m a Dr. Becky follower and am all-in on this mission, but the app felt like a short cut or not substantive enough to be helpful. Like so much of parenting, it’s a long game that takes consistent effort and time. However, recently, my son was melting down because of an unexpected and last minute change of plans and I felt out of practice and at a loss of what to do. In the moment, I just survived. But after, I opened the app and desperately typed into the chat bot: “What can I say to my DFK son in the moment to help him deal with unexpected change of plans?”  The response was validating, thoughtful, on point, and practical. It felt like I was on a live chat with Dr. Becky herself. I followed up asking for suggestions for skill building outside the moment and again, the app gave me several actionable ideas along with follow material and references. I was so pleasantly surprised and have returned for more. It is such a well implemented use of AI. The intention and thought behind this app is clear.

reviews.title: Revolutionary for Parents
reviews.contents: This app is a GAME changer for busy, exhausted, and overwhelmed parents. Finally, there is an app providing support and resources for the hardest and most important job in the world! We all spend more time than we want to on our phones, so why not make it count by upskilling and educating ourselves on how to meet our kids where they are, foster an environment of connection instead of consequences, and become sturdier, more confident versions of ourselves? My oldest daughter started kindergarten this week and she had a lot of first day nerves. On our drive over, I pulled up the app in the passenger seat and searched “separation anxiety”. I was instantly reminded of the powerful phrase “Mommy and Daddy always come back”. It made my daughter feel seen and supported, and we both felt sturdier after this simple yet impactful reminder. The combination of impact + efficiency is unparalleled and I already can’t imagine my parenting journey without this app. THANK YOU to the team who brought this to life - you are changing the world, one parent at a time.

reviews.title: Phenomenal
reviews.contents: First let me say, I’m a Christian, home schooling mother of 4, who struggles with anxiety and overwhelm. I believe it’s critical to direct my children to Christ and God’s written word as their source of peace, wisdom, and comfort. This app is absolutely wonderful in helping me to manage my own anxiety, and giving me bite sized morsels of wisdom and direction, which I can put into immediate action - daily! - Even throughout the day! The tools stay fresh, and help to over ride my own actions propensities! I feel so empowered. It’s literally like Christmas for me and my children throughout the day! The best part??? My three oldest (because the littlest is 8 months), have given me incredible, unsolicited feedback in their words and actions. My 11 year old has gone out of her way to thank me numerous times, just for saying, “I believe you,” and, “That does feel like a tricky situation. Tell me more!” Game changer!!! I can’t thank you and your team enough. God has blessed you with an incredible gift! So thankful we found you!

reviews.title: This is a must-have resource for every parent!
reviews.contents: Good Inside membership, and now the app, have literally transformed my life and my 7 y/o son’s. As we walked into the first day of 2nd grade this morning, he repeated a helpful mantra “Hi, sad. I see you. It makes sense I’m feeling sad, and I can cope with it.” As a deeply feeling kid (DFK), this is HUGE! Rather than be upset or overwhelmed by his feelings, he can name them, allow them, and remain hopeful that he won’t always feel this way. I feel so empowered as a parent to raise a confident kid (one who feels at home with and trusts himself and his feelings)! I couldn’t be more grateful for GI! And the app makes digesting content so manageable. I’m able to log in daily, spend 5 minutes or less, and leave with helpful tools and support to grow as a sturdy leader. You can set reminders for yourself that pop up when you need them most. If you are on the fence about membership, don’t wait one more day. You need Dr Becky and her team in your back pocket!

reviews.title: Dr Becky Delivers Again
reviews.contents:
If you are new to Dr. Becky, there are so many free ways for you to learn about her school of thought and whether or not you feel it is a good fit for you and your family (spoiler alert, I personally think it is pretty universal). You can listen to her podcast, find her on social media, or just google her and read what comes up. 

One thing that may not be as easy to see from a quick google search, is confirmation that she is committed to building actionable tools to help parents in need WHO ARE LIMITED ON TIME. This app really delivers on the promise that a 5 minute scroll while waiting to pick up your kid(s), in line at the store, or wherever you are on your phone, can actually give you memorable, actionable tips to make a real difference in your interactions with your kids. And if you have more than 5 minutes? It easily gives you rabbit holes you can go down to level up your parenting. The UI is also very modern and refreshing compared to other educational apps out there.

I’m excited to see what the team has cooked up for future updates, but even shortly after the release this app has already been very useful to me and my wife. If you’re considering joining Good Inside and checking out the app, I highly suggest you invest in yourself (and your family). The GI team is truly behind you, thinking about you and designing for you, and this app is solid evidence of that. 

Thanks GI team!

reviews.title: Most Helpful Guidance
reviews.contents: Good Inside has adjusted our thinking and patterns that were not helpful from the past.  Understanding a DFK and strong-willed child has been a game changer.  Has this been easy tho?  No way… lots of mistakes.  Even times I felt like a failure as a parent by the high levels that Good Inside promotes.  Yet Dr. Becky realistically makes room for our flaws & limitations.  We cannot do this perfectly and that is ok.  For our family, only maybe one issue out of 10 gets addressed per day, and it is enough for now.  I do the daily cards as I can in small bites.  I use the AI feature daily to vent, to ask questions, to dispute some of the answers, and get something that is more realistic for my family and my two kids that refuse any talking about feelings most of the time due to it feeling too vulnerable for them (& being children of a high-conflict divorce).   Thank you for this wonderful gift - we would be lost without it.

reviews.title: Saved my parenting
reviews.contents: I highly recommend this app to anyone struggling with parenting at all.  Even just a little bit. There is a wealth of information right at your fingertips. Whatever issue you’re facing with your kids, you can simply search for it and you’ll get workshops, videos, or written material to help you with that issue, not to mention the daily cards/deck you get that are tailored to your kids’ ages and issues.  Also live Q&A and the community section that I’ve hardly even dabbled in yet and even without that, it is well worth the money. So thankful for Dr. Becky. Before this app, I was messaging her and other popular parenting gurus with questions on instagram and would have to wait days for a response if any at all because they’re so popular they can’t possible read all their DMs and get back to everyone. Now I use the AI bot in the good inside app to ask my questions and to my surprise it is SUPER helpful!!!

reviews.title: A MUST!!!
reviews.contents: I am probably one of Dr Becky’s biggest fans so when I heard she was coming out with an app I was beyond excited!! Her philosophies and principles have guided my parenting journey from the beginning. I knew I wanted to parent differently from when I was raised, but I didn’t know how. Dr Becky provides all the tools and resources necessary to feel like a sturdy and confident parent. From potty learning to tantrums and other tricky situations, she has been the single best investment I’ve made in my life and my family. I am forever grateful to Dr Becky for helping me be the parent I wish I had. Her app has made her content even more accessible which has been a game changer! I love that I can quickly look up guidance needed in the moment. With the AI feature I can ask a question and have an answer/resources availabile instantly. I love you Dr Becky!! Thank you SO much 🙏🏻💛

reviews.title: Just in time and long term support
reviews.contents: I’m a full time “insta mom” to three wonderful step kids. We’ve all had to work through a difficult and very ugly custody modification process when bio mom chose to move to another state. I’ve been in counseling for years for my own stuff but nothing has supported me the way that Good Inside has. The app is a fabulous and thoughtful extension of the science and practice based support tools that Dr. Becky and the Good Inside team have built. The app makes those resources that much easier to access and is so tailor-able. I can get quick just in time reminders for sticky situations and tap into longer, more in depth tools when I have the time and am ready to do deeper inner-work. This is probably the most powerful transformative app out there and is unique for its focus on parents.

reviews.title: Worth every penny
reviews.contents: Only a couple weeks in to having the app and I already feel a huge shift in our home. I feel like a more confident parent and I have an overall happier calmer child. Still working on the behaviors I came to the app for (which I expected to be), but now I truly feel like I know how to handle each situation confidently and calmly. I can tell my child feels more settled because of my confidence and consistency. Between the hard moments, he’s less clingy, more joyful, affectionate and lighthearted. I can’t believe how quickly this has made a difference in how we’re all feeling, but it truly has. I was very skeptical about paying for an app like this, but I thought I’d give it a try after listening to some of her podcasts and talks. It’s SO worth the money already.
